title: Global View - Last Will And Testament
audio: mp3/212. Global View - Last Will And Testament.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have a very serious dialogue for you.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为您进行了非常严肃的对话。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We are going to talk about a will and testament, the last will and testament of someone.
segments.zh: 我们将谈论遗嘱和遗嘱，即某人的最后遗嘱和遗嘱。

segments.en: Alright, so what is a will and testament?
segments.zh: 好吧，那么什么是遗嘱和遗嘱？

segments.en: Well basically this is a document that someone writes, usually with a lawyer, that explains what to do with the person's body and their possessions, their things, after they die.
segments.zh: 好吧，基本上这是一个人写的文件，通常是和律师一起写的，它解释了如何处理人的身体和他们的财产，他们的东西，他们死后。

segments.en: So many people write these and the family will then use it to discover who gets to receive certain objects and what to do with this person's body.
segments.zh: 很多人写这些，然后家人会用它来发现谁可以接收某些物体以及如何处理这个人的身体。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So that is a last will and testament.
segments.zh: 所以这是最后的遗嘱和遗嘱。

segments.en: We are going to take a look at an example of one so you would see more or less in English how one is written.
segments.zh: 我们将看一个例子，这样你就会或多或少地用英文看到一个是如何写的。

segments.en: Now obviously they can be very long and very complex.
segments.zh: 现在显然它们可以很长而且非常复杂。

segments.en: So we've taken one that has some interesting words there that are a little bit more specific, a lot of legal terms there.
segments.zh: 所以我们拿了一个有一些更具体的有趣词，那里有很多法律术语。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to this dialogue for the first time and we'll be back shortly.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不第一次听这个对话，我们很快就会回来。

segments.en: Last will and testament of Luke Thompson.
segments.zh: 卢克·汤普森的最终遗嘱。

segments.en: I Luke Thompson residing in California, being of sound mind, do hereby declare this instrument to be my last will and testament.
segments.zh: 本人卢克·汤普森，现居加利福尼亚州，神志清醒，特此声明本文件为本人的最终遗嘱。

segments.en: I hereby revoke all previous wills and codicils.
segments.zh: 本人特此撤销此前订立的所有遗嘱及补充遗嘱。

segments.en: I direct that the disposition of my remains be as follows.
segments.zh: 我指示我的遗体的处置如下。

segments.en: I'm to be cremated and taken to the summit of Mount Everest where my ashes will forever remain at the ceiling of the earth.
segments.zh: 我的遗体应予火化，骨灰送至珠穆朗玛峰顶，永远留在世界之巅。

segments.en: I give all the rest and residue of my estate to my spouse, Betty Thompson, should she survive me for 60 days.
segments.zh: 如我的配偶贝蒂·汤普森在我去世后仍生存满六十天，我将全部剩余遗产留给她。

segments.en: If my spouse, Betty Thompson, does not survive me, I give all the rest and residue of my estate to English Pod.
segments.zh: 如果我的配偶贝蒂·汤普森先于我去世，我将全部剩余遗产留给 EnglishPod。

segments.en: If neither Betty Thompson nor English Pod survives me, I give all the rest and residue of my estate to my heirs as determined by the laws of the state of California relating to descent and distribution.
segments.zh: 如贝蒂·汤普森和 EnglishPod 均未存续至我去世之时，我将全部剩余遗产留给按照加利福尼亚州继承及遗产分配法律确定的继承人。

segments.en: I appoint Robert Porter to act as the executor of this will, to serve without bond.
segments.zh: 我指定罗伯特·波特担任本遗嘱的执行人，无须提供担保。

segments.en: Should Robert Porter be unable or unwilling to serve, then I appoint Jason Smalls to act as the executor of this will.
segments.zh: 如果罗伯特·波特不能或不愿服务，那么我任命杰森·斯莫尔斯作为本遗嘱的执行人。

segments.en: I herewith affix my signature to this will on this the 23rd of May, 2010 in the presence of the following witnesses who witnessed and subscribed this will at my request and in my presence.
segments.zh: 本人于二〇一〇年五月二十三日在下列见证人在场的情况下签署本遗嘱；见证人应本人请求，在本人面前见证并签署本遗嘱。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now we're going to take a look at five key words on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们要看看关于语言外卖的五个关键词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Okay, the first word here in Language Takeaway comes from the very beginning of this monologue.
segments.zh: 好的，语言外卖中的第一个词来自独白的一开始。

segments.en: We're reading the last will in Testament aloud.
segments.zh: 我们正在大声朗读遗嘱中的最后遗嘱。

segments.en: I Luke Thompson residing in California being of sound mind.
segments.zh: 我卢克·汤普森（Luke Thompson）居住在加利福尼亚州，心智健全。

segments.en: Sound as an adjective.
segments.zh: 声音作为形容词。

segments.en: What does this mean?
segments.zh: 这是什么意思？

segments.en: That's very interesting.
segments.zh: 这很有趣。

segments.en: So he says, I am in sound mind and sound is an adjective to describe I am in a good state of mind.
segments.zh: 所以他说，我在健全的头脑中，声音是一个形容词来形容我处于良好的心态。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it means not having any problems or logical or unaffected.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着没有任何问题或逻辑或不受影响。

segments.en: Basically I'm not crazy.
segments.zh: 基本上我不是疯了。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I'm not crazy.
segments.zh: 我没有疯。

segments.en: I don't have any problems.
segments.zh: 我没有任何问题。

segments.en: We can say this about other things too.
segments.zh: 我们也可以说其他事情。

segments.en: We can say he's of sound body.
segments.zh: 我们可以说他是健全的身体。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: That means that he is healthy.
segments.zh: 这意味着他很健康。

segments.en: He has no problems with his body.
segments.zh: 他的身体没有任何问题。

segments.en: Or I could say, Marco, that's a really good decision.
segments.zh: 或者我可以说，马可，这是一个非常好的决定。

segments.en: It's a sound decision.
segments.zh: 这是一个合理的决定。

segments.en: So again, that's also a way of saying good or it will work.
segments.zh: 再说一次，这也是一种说好或它会起作用的方式。

segments.en: It will work.
segments.zh: 它会起作用。

segments.en: It's a good decision.
segments.zh: 这是一个很好的决定。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you can use this adjective with sound body, sound mind or a sound decision.
segments.zh: 因此，您可以将这个形容词与健全的身体、健全的头脑或健全的决定一起使用。

segments.en: Or sometimes some people even say, I think in Ireland, they say, oh, he's a really sound guy.
segments.zh: 或者有时甚至有些人甚至说，我想在爱尔兰，他们说，哦，他是一个非常健全的人。

segments.en: Oh, so he's a good guy.
segments.zh: 哦，所以他是个好人。

segments.en: He's a good guy.
segments.zh: 他是个好人。

segments.en: Very interesting.
segments.zh: 很有意思。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So sound body, sound mind, sound guy.
segments.zh: 所以健全的身体，健全的头脑，健全的家伙。

segments.en: Moving on, he was talking about the will and he says, I hereby revoke all previous wills and codicils.
segments.zh: 继续前进，他在谈论遗嘱，他说，我特此撤销所有以前的遗嘱和附则。

segments.en: The verb here is to revoke.
segments.zh: 这里的动词是撤销。

segments.en: To revoke.
segments.zh: 撤销。

segments.en: This is something that a lot of people hear in America when they drive their car too fast.
segments.zh: 这是很多人在美国开车太快时听到的。

segments.en: The police catch them and the police revoke their driver's license.
segments.zh: 警察抓获他们，警察吊销了他们的驾驶执照。

segments.en: And that basically means to take away.
segments.zh: 这基本上意味着带走。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or to take, right?
segments.zh: 还是拿，对吧？

segments.en: To take away from.
segments.zh: 带走。

segments.en: So this man here, Luke Thompson, what he's saying is, I revoke all previous wills.
segments.zh: 所以这里的这个人，卢克汤普森，他说的是，我撤销了以前的所有遗嘱。

segments.en: That means any other will that I wrote before, it's not good anymore.
segments.zh: 这意味着我之前写的任何其他意志，它不再好了。

segments.en: I'm throwing it away.
segments.zh: 我把它扔掉。

segments.en: This is the only one that will exist.
segments.zh: 这是唯一将存在的一种。

segments.en: So you can use this word revoke with many aspects.
segments.zh: 所以你可以使用这个词有很多方面的撤销。

segments.en: For example, sometimes employees will get their benefits revoked by the company because maybe they don't have enough money anymore.
segments.zh: 例如，有时员工会被公司撤销他们的福利，因为他们可能不再有足够的钱了。

segments.en: Or maybe they're bad employees.
segments.zh: 或者他们是坏员工。

segments.en: Or maybe they were bad employees.
segments.zh: 或者他们是坏员工。

segments.en: That's too bad.
segments.zh: 太遗憾了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So to revoke.
segments.zh: 所以要撤销。

segments.en: Now, moving on, he was talking about his estate.
segments.zh: 现在，继续前进，他在谈论他的财产。

segments.en: So this is very interesting because he says, I give all the rest and residue of my estate to my spouse.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣，因为他说，我把我所有的剩余和剩余财产都交给了我的配偶。

segments.en: Okay, estate, it sounds like a very fancy word.
segments.zh: 好吧，庄园，这听起来像是一个非常花哨的词。

segments.en: It is a fancy word.
segments.zh: 这是一个花哨的词。

segments.en: Sometimes we use this word to mean someone's property, their house.
segments.zh: 有时我们用这个词来表示某人的财产，他们的房子。

segments.en: But in a will, this means everything the person owns.
segments.zh: 但在遗嘱中，这意味着这个人拥有的一切。

segments.en: House, car, things, pets, stocks, investments.
segments.zh: 房子、汽车、东西、宠物、股票、投资。

segments.en: The estate is essentially everything the person owns as a kind of one unit.
segments.zh: 庄园本质上是一个人拥有的一切作为一种单位。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So anything that is yours or you may have bought.
segments.zh: 所以任何是你的，或者你可能已经买了。

segments.en: Just consider the estate is a big bag, right?
segments.zh: 只是考虑一下庄园是一个大包，对吧？

segments.en: That's your estate.
segments.zh: 那是你的财产。

segments.en: And inside this bag is everything that you own.
segments.zh: 这个包里面是你拥有的一切。

segments.en: You might see advertisements in fact in America or in England for estate sales.
segments.zh: 您可能会在美国或英国看到用于房地产销售的广告。

segments.en: This means that when someone passes away, when they die, their family will sell their things and this is an estate sale.
segments.zh: 这意味着当一个人去世时，当他们死去时，他们的家人会卖掉他们的东西，这是一个房地产销售。

segments.en: You can find beautiful, interesting things in estate sales.
segments.zh: 您可以在房地产销售中找到美丽、有趣的东西。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Very interesting.
segments.zh: 很有意思。

segments.en: So that is a person's estate.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个人的财产。

segments.en: Now remember this is in the legal terms because you also have other things like real estate.
segments.zh: 现在请记住，这是法律条款中的，因为您还有其他东西，比如房地产。

segments.en: And as you mentioned, which would be a house, right?
segments.zh: 正如你所提到的，哪个是房子，对吧？

segments.en: Okay, now apart from his estate, he was telling everyone as to how they should take care of his body or what they should do with it.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在除了他的财产外，他还告诉大家他们应该如何照顾他的身体，或者他们应该如何处理它。

segments.en: And he said, well, I am to be cremated.
segments.zh: 他说，好吧，我要火化。

segments.en: Okay, this is important.
segments.zh: 好吧，这很重要。

segments.en: When a person dies, there are generally two options.
segments.zh: 当一个人死去时，通常有两种选择。

segments.en: Their body can be buried in a casket in the ground.
segments.zh: 他们的尸体可以埋在地下的棺材里。

segments.en: That means they're put in the earth.
segments.zh: 这意味着它们被置于地球上。

segments.en: But a lot of people choose to be cremated.
segments.zh: 但是很多人选择火化。

segments.en: Okay, that means that their body will be burned and their ashes, that means the things that are left after they are burned, they will be taken somewhere else.
segments.zh: 好吧，这意味着他们的身体会被烧毁，他们的骨灰，这意味着他们被烧毁后留下的东西，他们会被带到别处。

segments.en: Like in a bowl or a pot.
segments.zh: 就像在碗或锅里一样。

segments.en: And in this case, that's what the person wants.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，这就是这个人想要的。

segments.en: He wants to be cremated.
segments.zh: 他想被火化。

segments.en: So that would be the verb to cremate and the noun would be a cremation.
segments.zh: 所以这将是火化的动词，名词将是火葬。

segments.en: And what is going to happen to all this stuff?
segments.zh: 所有这些东西会发生什么？

segments.en: Basically it's going to be given away to his wife, to English Pod, and to his heirs.
segments.zh: 基本上它会被送给他的妻子、英国人和他的继承人。

segments.en: This is our next word.
segments.zh: 这是我们的下一个词。

segments.en: What is an heir?
segments.zh: 什么是继承人？

segments.en: Now, if you notice, the H is silent there.
segments.zh: 现在，如果你注意到了，H 在那里是静音的。

segments.en: So his heirs.
segments.zh: 所以他的继承人。

segments.en: And those are basically his children.
segments.zh: 这些基本上是他的孩子。

segments.en: His daughters or his sons.
segments.zh: 他的女儿或他的儿子。

segments.en: Right, my heirs are the people who are related to me, who in this case will receive some of my things.
segments.zh: 对，我的继承人是与我有关系的人，在这种情况下，他们会收到我的一些东西。

segments.en: Now, is it only the children or also it could be maybe any other relative?
segments.zh: 现在，是只有孩子还是也可能是其他亲戚？

segments.en: It could be any other relative.
segments.zh: 它可以是任何其他亲戚。

segments.en: You could say, I'm his heir, he's my great uncle.
segments.zh: 你可以说，我是他的继承人，他是我的叔叔。

segments.en: It means we're related but we're not necessarily father and daughter or grandfather and granddaughter.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们是亲戚，但我们不一定是父亲和女儿或祖父和孙女。

segments.en: An heir is someone who is related to the family.
segments.zh: 继承人是与家庭有关的人。

segments.en: It doesn't have to be a certain relationship.
segments.zh: 它不必是某种关系。

segments.en: And now it's interesting because from this word we can get inheritance.
segments.zh: 现在很有趣，因为从这个词我们可以得到继承。

segments.en: Now we didn't find it in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 现在我们没有在对话中找到它。

segments.en: So it's very interesting because they're very similar in spelling, right?
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣，因为它们的拼写非常相似，对吧？

segments.en: Inheritance and heir.
segments.zh: 继承人和继承人。

segments.en: Right, good to remember.
segments.zh: 对，很好记住。

segments.en: Yeah, good to remember.
segments.zh: 是的，很好记住。

segments.en: You switch the E and the I's, right?
segments.zh: 你切换E和I，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So inheritance is a thing.
segments.zh: 所以继承是一个东西。

segments.en: You can receive this.
segments.zh: 你可以收到这个。

segments.en: So I received an inheritance from my great grandmother.
segments.zh: 所以我从我的曾祖母那里得到了遗产。

segments.en: That means I received some money or some things.
segments.zh: 这意味着我收到了一些钱或一些东西。

segments.en: That means you were that person's heir.
segments.zh: 这意味着你是那个人的继承人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Or in his inheritance, he received a large house.
segments.zh: 或者在他的遗产中，他得到了一座大房子。

segments.en: He was the heir to a great fortune.
segments.zh: 他是一笔财富的继承人。

segments.en: Okay, interesting.
segments.zh: 好，挺有意思。

segments.en: So again, inheritance wasn't in the dialogue but I think it's worth mentioning.
segments.zh: 再说一次，对话不在对话中，但我认为它值得一提。

segments.en: And I think now we can move on to four very interesting items that we have for you on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我认为现在我们可以继续讨论我们在 Fluency Builder 上为您提供的四个非常有趣的项目。

segments.en: Okay, these first two are words that we normally read or hear in legal documents.
segments.zh: 好的，这两个是我们通常在法律文件中阅读或听到的单词。

segments.en: And I want to place emphasis on the fact that we don't really say them in spoken English.
segments.zh: 我想强调我们并没有用英语口语说出它们的事实。

segments.en: So remember that these are more formal terms.
segments.zh: 所以请记住，这些是更正式的术语。

segments.en: The first one is hereby.
segments.zh: 第一个是特此。

segments.en: I hereby declare.
segments.zh: 我特此声明。

segments.en: That means now.
segments.zh: 这意味着现在。

segments.en: With this word, with this spoken sentence, this will happen.
segments.zh: 有了这个词，用这个口语句子，这将发生。

segments.en: I think we've seen it like in movies sometimes.
segments.zh: 我想我们有时会在电影中看到它。

segments.en: I hereby declare this country in the name of England.
segments.zh: 我特此以英格兰的名义宣布这个国家。

segments.en: I hereby declare you man and wife.
segments.zh: 我特此宣布你夫妻。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That means in this moment, this happens.
segments.zh: 这意味着在这一刻，这会发生。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And a very similar word that we also saw in the dialogue is herewith.
segments.zh: 我们也在对话中看到的一个非常相似的词。

segments.en: So in the Will and Testament, we hear Luke Thompson who says, I herewith affix my signature.
segments.zh: 所以在遗嘱和遗嘱中，我们听到卢克·汤普森说，我特此加盖我的签名。

segments.en: That means with the action of signing my name, signing my signature, this will be completed.
segments.zh: 这意味着签署我的姓名，签署我的签名，这将完成。

segments.en: So I herewith, you have to have an action, not just a word.
segments.zh: 所以我随即，你必须有一个行动，而不仅仅是一个词。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I herewith.
segments.zh: 所以我在此。

segments.en: I herewith attach my seal.
segments.zh: 我在此附上我的印章。

segments.en: A seal is like a stamp.
segments.zh: 印章就像邮票。

segments.en: Very common in the old days when you had real letters.
segments.zh: 在你有真正的信件的过去很常见。

segments.en: But I herewith attach my seal and give my approval to this document.
segments.zh: 但我在此附上我的印章并批准本文件。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So it has to be something physical.
segments.zh: 所以它必须是物理的东西。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So if maybe you're writing like this very classic letter and you say, I herewith include a lock of my hair.
segments.zh: 所以如果你写的是这封非常经典的信，你说，我特此包括一把头发。

segments.en: Oh, how romantic.
segments.zh: 哦，多么浪漫。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That's kind of creepy.
segments.zh: 这有点令人毛骨悚然。

segments.en: But you're including or attaching physically, right?
segments.zh: 但是你在包括或附着身体上，对吧？

segments.en: I guess the modern version of herewith would be attach.
segments.zh: 我想这里的现代版本将是附加的。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Herewith, hereby.
segments.zh: 特此，特此。

segments.en: We've got another phrase here that you might hear more commonly.
segments.zh: 我们在这里有另一个短语，您可能会更常见地听到。

segments.en: The beginning of the Will and Testament, there's a phrase as follows.
segments.zh: 遗嘱和遗嘱的开头，有一个短语如下。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I direct that the disposition of my remains be as follows.
segments.zh: 我指示我的遗体的处置如下。

segments.en: So with my body do as follows.
segments.zh: 所以用我的身体做如下。

segments.en: So basically this is a very common way of putting this in a sentence to indicate that you're going to start to list items.
segments.zh: 所以基本上这是一种非常常见的将其放在句子中的方式，以指示您将开始列出项目。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or give instructions.
segments.zh: 或给出指示。

segments.en: Give instructions.
segments.zh: 给出指示。

segments.en: So for example, to make a loaf of bread, do as follows.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，要制作一条面包，请按以下步骤操作。

segments.en: Number one, get some flour.
segments.zh: 第一，拿点面粉。

segments.en: Number two, add some water.
segments.zh: 第二，加点水。

segments.en: So this is a way for us to say, listen, I'm going to give you instructions or a list.
segments.zh: 所以这是我们说的一种方式，听着，我会给你指示或清单。

segments.en: Pay attention.
segments.zh: 注意。

segments.en: So please do as follows.
segments.zh: 所以请按如下操作。

segments.en: Please act as follows.
segments.zh: 请按如下操作。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And our last word that we have here, going back to herewith, he said, I herewith affix my signature.
segments.zh: 他说，我们在这里的最后一句话，回到这里，他说，我特此附上我的签名。

segments.en: What does it mean when you affix?
segments.zh: 贴上是什么意思？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Affix is a word we have a number of other words for these days, so you rarely hear it.
segments.zh: 词缀是我们现在还有许多其他词的词，所以你很少听到它。

segments.en: It means to attach or to include.
segments.zh: 它的意思是附加或包括。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I herewith affix my signature would be attach my signature.
segments.zh: 因此，我在此附上我的签名将附上我的签名。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I herewith provide my signature or I herewith affix my address or I herewith affix something.
segments.zh: 我特此提供我的签名或我在此附上我的地址或我特此附加一些东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Really interesting stuff.
segments.zh: 真的很有趣的东西。

segments.en: You'll obviously see this very commonly with legal documents such as these, even though it is like older English, it's still very commonly used.
segments.zh: 您显然会在诸如此类的法律文件中很常见地看到这一点，即使它像较旧的英语一样，它仍然很常用。

segments.en: I guess because the law is so old.
segments.zh: 我猜是因为法律太古老了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Definitely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: And I think that it's worth listening to today's monologue one more time.
segments.zh: 而且我认为值得再听一次今天的独白。

segments.en: Think about some of the words that we've just discussed and we'll be back in a moment.
segments.zh: 想想我们刚刚讨论过的一些单词，我们一会儿就回来了。

segments.en: Last will and testament of Luke Thompson.
segments.zh: 卢克·汤普森的最终遗嘱。

segments.en: I Luke Thompson residing in California, being of sound mind do hereby declare this instrument to be my last will and testament.
segments.zh: 我卢克·汤普森（Luke Thompson）居住在加利福尼亚，心智健全，特此宣布该乐器为我的最后遗嘱和遗嘱。

segments.en: I hereby revoke all previous wills and codicils.
segments.zh: 本人特此撤销此前订立的所有遗嘱及补充遗嘱。

segments.en: I direct that the disposition of my remains be as follows.
segments.zh: 我指示我的遗体的处置如下。

segments.en: I'm to be cremated and taken to the summit of Mount Everest where my ashes will forever remain at the ceiling of the earth.
segments.zh: 我的遗体应予火化，骨灰送至珠穆朗玛峰顶，永远留在世界之巅。

segments.en: I give all the rest and residue of my estate to my spouse, Betty Thompson, should she survive me for 60 days.
segments.zh: 如我的配偶贝蒂·汤普森在我去世后仍生存满六十天，我将全部剩余遗产留给她。

segments.en: If my spouse, Betty Thompson, does not survive me, I give all the rest and residue of my estate to English Pod.
segments.zh: 如果我的配偶贝蒂·汤普森先于我去世，我将全部剩余遗产留给 EnglishPod。

segments.en: If neither Betty Thompson nor English Pod survives me, I give all the rest and residue of my estate to my heirs as determined by the laws of the state of California relating to descent and distribution.
segments.zh: 如贝蒂·汤普森和 EnglishPod 均未存续至我去世之时，我将全部剩余遗产留给按照加利福尼亚州继承及遗产分配法律确定的继承人。

segments.en: I appoint Robert Porter to act as the executor of this will, to serve without bond.
segments.zh: 我指定罗伯特·波特担任本遗嘱的执行人，无须提供担保。

segments.en: Should Robert Porter be unable or unwilling to serve, then I appoint Jason Smalls to act as the executor of this will.
segments.zh: 如果罗伯特·波特不能或不愿服务，那么我任命杰森·斯莫尔斯作为本遗嘱的执行人。

segments.en: I herewith affix my signature to this will on this the 23rd of May, 2010 in the presence of the following witnesses who witnessed and subscribed this will at my request and in my presence.
segments.zh: 本人于二〇一〇年五月二十三日在下列见证人在场的情况下签署本遗嘱；见证人应本人请求，在本人面前见证并签署本遗嘱。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.

segments.en: So this is a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: Now I wonder, within the will or within the estate, do you also acquire a person's debts?
segments.zh: 现在我想知道，在遗嘱内还是在遗产中，你也获得了一个人的债务吗？

segments.en: Ah, that's a good question.
segments.zh: 啊，这是个好问题。

segments.en: Because I know in some countries you do, in some countries you don't.
segments.zh: 因为我知道在某些国家，在某些国家，您不知道。

segments.en: I know in like some cases, some heirs have found themselves in some legal problems because all of a sudden they inherited that person's debts and stuff like that.
segments.zh: 我知道在某些情况下，一些继承人发现自己遇到了一些法律问题，因为他们突然继承了那个人的债务之类的东西。

segments.en: I think that does happen, especially for people whose properties are mortgaged.
segments.zh: 我认为这确实发生了，特别是对于财产被抵押的人。

segments.en: For example, if your uncle has a house and he didn't pay for it with cash, he has a mortgage and he dies and you inherit this house, you also inherit the mortgage.
segments.zh: 例如，如果你的叔叔有房子，他没有用现金支付，他有抵押贷款，他死了，你继承了这所房子，你也继承了抵押贷款。

segments.en: So sometimes inheritances are not always a good thing.
segments.zh: 所以有时继承并不总是一件好事。

segments.en: I think this happened more in the past.
segments.zh: 我认为这发生在过去更多。

segments.en: There are more protections and safeguards for people today.
segments.zh: 今天有更多的保护和保护措施对人们。

segments.en: But definitely, I mean, what is it like in Ecuador?
segments.zh: 但绝对，我的意思是，厄瓜多尔是什么样的？

segments.en: Do people inherit debt?
segments.zh: 人们会继承债务吗？

segments.en: Yeah, I think most, well, obviously most banks when they give out loans or a mortgage, they have somebody that will kind of co-sign on these things.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为大多数，好吧，显然大多数银行在提供贷款或抵押时，他们都会有人在这些事情上共同签署。

segments.en: And I imagine, I'm not really very sure, but I know that if you inherit an estate that has a mortgage, you are forced to pay it.
segments.zh: 我想，我不太确定，但我知道如果你继承了一个有抵押贷款的财产，你就被迫支付。

segments.en: And if you can't, then they will make that other person who co-signed it responsible if he still exists.
segments.zh: 如果你不能，那么如果他仍然存在，他们将让共同签署它的另一个人负责。

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: In these legal systems, it's sometimes very strange because it seems like there would be a lot of gaps.
segments.zh: 在这些法律体系中，有时会很奇怪，因为似乎会有很多差距。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And everyone wants to protect themselves.
segments.zh: 每个人都想保护自己。

segments.en: So we've got the bank that wants to protect itself.
segments.zh: 所以我们有银行想要保护自己。

segments.en: It gives a loan, it wants the money back.
segments.zh: 它提供贷款，它想要退款。

segments.en: And a person who wants to protect himself from maybe a relative who dies and has debt.
segments.zh: 一个想要保护自己免受可能是死去并有债务的亲戚的人。

segments.en: So I'm curious to know what our users have to say.
segments.zh: 所以我很想知道我们的用户要说什么。

segments.zh: 你们国家的情况如何？

segments.zh: 大多数人有遗嘱和遗嘱吗？

segments.zh: 或者如果有人死了，他们没有遗嘱和遗嘱，会发生什么？

segments.zh: 这也是一个很好的问题。
